findings.desc: pinn_report_render trusts caller-supplied benchmarkJson/benchmarkPath and returns or renders report claims unchanged. handlers/pinn-claim-admissibility.ts:92-95 casts parsed JSON as PinnBenchmarkReport, and :110-113 returns it directly for JSON or passes it to renderPinnReportText. core/pinn-claim-admissibility.ts:580-591 then prints report.claims.productionDone/authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone/pdeCorrectnessClaim and report.boundary as supplied. Verified by direct handler invocation: a supplied report with those flags true renders productionDone: true, authorityDone: true, fullAuthorityDone: true, pdeCorrectnessClaim: true, and a caller-controlled external Authority completion boundary. This violates the pack boundary that local reporting must not claim PDE correctness, production readiness, or external Authority completion; supplied reports need validation/normalization or rejection before rendering.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by normalizing/rejecting caller-supplied benchmark reports before pinn_report_render returns or renders them; malicious true completion/correctness claims and caller-controlled boundary now throw. Verified by npm run test:pinn-claim-admissibility and CLI pinn_report_render claims=false/boundary fixed.

findings.desc: M4 test/evidence coverage claims the deterministic B1-B15 benchmark, but the implemented/tested injection corpus does not match the governing plan. The plan requires B1-B15 cases such as spec changed while residual reused, BC changed while BC report reused, checkpoint mismatch, collocation changes, narrowed grid, baseline benchmark mismatch, stale figure provenance, missing seed/config, low-loss/high-OOS residual, threshold changed, code changed after checkpoint, metric changed, and manually edited figures/tables (docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-pinn-claim-admissibility-execution-plan.md:171-187). The runtime corpus instead defines B1-B15 as missing identity, missing/failing receipts, verifier hash mismatch, generic stale receipt, production/PDE overclaims, and missing adapters (packages/main/src/core/pinn-claim-admissibility.ts:151-166), and the smoke only asserts those substituted reason codes (packages/main/src/tasks/pinn-claim-admissibility-smoke.ts:32-46). As a result, npm run test:pinn-claim-admissibility and pinn_benchmark_run can pass without exercising several required B1-B15 failure modes, so TEST would overclaim M4 coverage.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by aligning PINN_FAILURE_INJECTIONS B1-B15 to the governing plan failure set and adding smoke assertions for exact B1-B15 titles plus expected A4 block reasons. Verified by npm run test:pinn-claim-admissibility and pinn_benchmark_run PASS with 15/15 A4 rejections.

findings.desc: Duplicate verifier receipts for the same adapter are silently collapsed by Map construction in packages/main/src/core/pinn-claim-admissibility.ts:385, so an evidence payload containing a stale/failing residual receipt followed by a clean residual receipt advances with allowed=true and no reasons. This violates the fail-closed/ambiguous-evidence boundary for the PINN claim-admissibility pack; duplicate adapter receipts should be rejected before selecting a receipt.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by detecting duplicate adapter receipts before receipt selection and adding duplicate_receipt fail-closed reason. Smoke now covers stale/failing residual followed by clean duplicate and requires allowed=false.

findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-pinn-claim-admissibility-execution-plan.md now states M0-M5 local runtime artifacts are delivered (lines 294-297) and says M0-M3 cover verifier adapters/gate transitions, but the unchanged Milestone 2/3 text still promises verifier scripts/adapters that write machine-readable evidence and transition enforcement (lines 247-267). The delivered runtime is read-only: handlers only consume evidenceJson/evidencePath or deterministic fixtures (packages/main/src/handlers/pinn-claim-admissibility.ts lines 85-95, 100-113), core fixtures synthesize receipts in-process (packages/main/src/core/pinn-claim-admissibility.ts lines 218-246), and command policy says the commands write nothing/cannot satisfy DONE or release readiness (packages/main/src/core/command-policy.ts lines 215-217). Update the doc/status language to say receipt schema/adapter receipt checks and diagnostic nextAction reporting were delivered, or deliver actual receipt-producing verifier scripts and lifecycle gate integration before TEST.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed decision doc wording to describe delivered read-only runtime scope: receipt checks, deterministic fixtures/benchmark, diagnostic nextAction/reporting, sanitized reports; explicitly out of scope are evidence-producing verifier scripts, lifecycle mutation, PDE correctness proof, production Authority, and remote release.

findings.desc: pinn_report_render still returns caller-supplied top-level overclaim fields from benchmarkJson/benchmarkPath in JSON mode when their values are non-boolean true. normalizeBenchmarkReport only rejects rawReport[field] === true or claims[field] === true, then returns { ...report, claims: SAFE_REPORT_CLAIMS, boundary: PINN_BOUNDARY_PARAGRAPH }, preserving extra top-level deploymentReadyClaim/externalCompletionClaim/terminalCompletionClaim/pdeCorrectnessClaim and retired productionDone/authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone fields. Verified by direct handler invocation against packages/main/dist: a supplied benchmark with those top-level fields set to string "true" returns them unchanged in the JSON result, even though nested claims are false and boundary is normalized. This violates the round-2 concept boundary that pinn_report_render must no longer render or return caller-supplied overclaim fields from benchmarkJson/benchmarkPath.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by rejecting true-ish supplied report overclaim fields and returning an allowlisted sanitized report shape without arbitrary caller top-level fields; smoke and direct probes cover string top-level overclaims, and full lattice validate passed with 18/18 story verification intents covered.

findings.desc: pinn_claim_check still accepts narrative completion overclaims. The boundaryViolation text matcher rejects deploymentReadyClaim/externalCompletionClaim/PDE wording and direct boolean fields, but it omits terminalCompletionClaim/terminal completion and retired narrative tokens such as productionDone/fullAuthorityDone. A complete evidence payload supplied via --evidencePath with narrativeClaim="terminalCompletionClaim: true" or "productionDone: true" returns allowed=true,nextAction=advance instead of claim_boundary_violation, so legacy/new completion overclaims can bypass the local claim boundary.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by extending claim boundary detection to true-ish direct values and narrative assignment patterns for terminalCompletionClaim and dynamic legacy completion fields; smoke/direct probes cover terminal and legacy narrative overclaims, and full lattice validate passed with 18/18 story verification intents covered.

findings.desc: pinn_report_render still re-emits caller-injected completion/PDE correctness claims from allowlisted benchmark fields. normalizeBenchmarkReport rejects top-level/claims overclaim fields, but then returns caller-controlled suiteStatus and artifactIndex unchanged (handlers/pinn-claim-admissibility.ts:133-143); renderPinnReportText prints those values directly (core/pinn-claim-admissibility.ts:638-641). Repro: call createPinnClaimAdmissibilityHandlers({}).pinn_report_render({ benchmarkJson: JSON.stringify({ ...runPinnClaimBenchmark(), suiteStatus: "deploymentReadyClaim: true", artifactIndex: [{ id: "terminalCompletionClaim: true", kind: "claim-boundary", digest: "pdeCorrectnessClaim: true" }] }), format: "text" }); output includes suiteStatus: deploymentReadyClaim: true and artifactIndex terminal/PDE overclaim strings. JSON mode also returns those strings in suiteStatus/artifactIndex. This violates the local/admissibility-only report boundary because supplied benchmark content can still surface completion/PDE correctness claims.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by deep-scanning supplied benchmark reports before rendering/returning them; overclaim assignment strings or narrative completion/PDE assertions inside suiteStatus, artifactIndex, or any nested supplied report text now reject with refuses benchmark report overclaims. Verified by smoke, direct JSON/text probes, retired vocabulary guard, build, and full lattice validate.

findings.desc: normalizeBenchmarkReport sanitizes top-level and claims overclaim fields, but then returns untrusted nested supplied report structures verbatim at packages/main/src/handlers/pinn-claim-admissibility.ts:133-143 (notably report.injections/report.arms/report.a4/report.artifactIndex). Repro: call pinn_report_render with format:"json" and benchmarkJson built from runPinnClaimBenchmark() plus injections:[{...benchmark.injections[0], deploymentReadyClaim:"true"}]. The JSON result preserves result.injections[0].deploymentReadyClaim === "true", while text mode does not render that field. This lets supplied report JSON carry arbitrary nested overclaim fields and makes JSON/text report boundary behavior inconsistent.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by rebuilding supplied benchmark reports through typed nested sanitizers instead of returning caller-controlled injections, arms, a4, or artifactIndex objects verbatim; true-ish overclaim keys anywhere in nested data now reject, and arbitrary nested fields are not preserved. Verified by smoke, direct benchmarkJson/benchmarkPath probes, build, guard, and full lattice validate.

findings.desc: Quality blocker: quoted JSON-like assignment strings bypass the true-ish overclaim boundary. Repro: handlers.pinn_report_render({benchmarkJson: JSON.stringify({...benchmark, artifactIndex:[{...benchmark.artifactIndex[0], digest:"\"terminalCompletionClaim\": true"}, ...benchmark.artifactIndex.slice(1)]}), format:"text"}) returns rendered text instead of refusing benchmark report overclaims; evaluatePinnClaim({...buildCompletePinnEvidence("C9"), narrativeClaim:"\"terminalCompletionClaim\": true"}) returns allowed=true. Root cause: REPORT_FIELD_OVERCLAIM_PATTERN at packages/main/src/handlers/pinn-claim-admissibility.ts:79 and fieldOverclaimPattern at packages/main/src/core/pinn-claim-admissibility.ts:371 require the claim field to be followed immediately by whitespace/colon/equal, so quoted claim keys are missed. This leaves JSON/text report behavior and claim-boundary narrative checks open to re-emitting or accepting true-ish overclaim strings.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by allowing optional quotes around active and dynamic legacy overclaim field names in both claim-boundary and supplied-report overclaim patterns. Smoke and direct probes now cover quoted JSON-like assignment strings in narrative claims and supplied report artifact strings; build, PINN smoke, retired vocabulary guard, and full lattice validate all pass.

findings.desc: pinn_claim_check narrative boundary still accepts passive PDE correctness overclaims. Direct probe shows narrativeClaim="PDE correctness proved", "PDE correctness verified", and "PDE correctness guaranteed" return allowed=true with no claim_boundary_violation, while only "proves PDE correctness" is blocked. This leaves the local-only admissibility boundary inconsistent with pinn_report_render, which rejects the same passive PDE correctness phrases in supplied benchmark reports.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by extending claim narrative boundary detection to passive PDE correctness phrases such as proved, verified, guaranteed, and validated. Smoke/direct probes cover passive PDE narrative claims and full lattice validate passed.

findings.desc: F-006 numeric true-ish direct overclaim gap remains: evaluatePinnClaim blocks quoted JSON-like assignment strings and string/bool direct overclaims, but direct evidence JSON with terminalCompletionClaim: 1 is still allowed/advance. Core TRUEISH_BOUNDARY_VALUES includes "1" and handler supplied-report scanning treats numeric 1 as unsafe, so direct claim boundary handling is inconsistent with the runtime overclaim contract. Repro: buildCompletePinnEvidence("C9"); input.terminalCompletionClaim = 1; evaluatePinnClaim(input) returns allowed=true instead of claim_boundary_violation.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by treating numeric 1 as true-ish in direct claim-boundary fields, matching supplied-report behavior for numeric true-ish values. Smoke/direct probes cover active and legacy numeric overclaim fields and full lattice validate passed.
